{{Top|leg}}
A '''Gloan tree''' was a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. The local species the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] made their homes in these trees. These structures, situated high above the ground, were built with saliva and mud.
